name: Approved FAQ chatbot
description: Answer a visitor from reviewed FAQ text, or explain how to reach a person.
input: A question and an optional request for a person.
check: Validate the request and model-selected article IDs.
result: Exact approved answer text with sources, or a clear human handoff.
boundary: A valid FAQ can still be irrelevant. Test answer selection with your own questions. A handoff does not create a support ticket.
terms: chatbot faq support answers knowledge human escalation

name: Business-hours status
description: Give a receptionist an exact open or closed answer, including lunch breaks and overnight shifts.
input: Your weekly intervals, IANA time zone and closure dates.
check: Apply current local time, interval boundaries and overnight rules.
result: Open or closed status with the local date and time.
boundary: Reports configured hours, not staff presence. Test your real timezone and daylight-saving policy before activation.
terms: hours schedule receptionist overnight lunch closure timezone

name: Appointment availability
description: Check a proposed appointment interval in Google Calendar before offering it to a customer.
input: A requested start and end time with explicit timezone offsets.
check: Validate the interval and ask Google Calendar whether it is free.
result: Available, busy or an explicit unverified-provider response.
boundary: Availability is a snapshot. This workflow does not reserve a slot or prevent a later competing booking.
terms: calendar availability time booking appointment scheduling

name: Confirmed appointment booking
description: Create a private calendar event only after an explicit confirmation and availability check.
input: A confirmed appointment, time interval and stable request ID.
check: Validate confirmation, check availability and verify the returned event.
result: A verified event identity or a specific invalid, busy or unconfirmed response.
boundary: Lookup and creation are separate operations. Serialize competing writers and reconcile uncertain results before retrying.

name: Callback notification
description: Let staff know when a caller explicitly asks for a callback.
input: A validated callback request and configured staff inbox.
check: Validate the request, send through Gmail and inspect the receipt.
result: Mail-provider acceptance or an unconfirmed-send response.
boundary: Provider acceptance is not inbox delivery, a completed callback or a booked appointment.

name: Cited editorial packet
description: Keep exact source evidence beside AI-generated editorial ideas for a person to review.
input: A topic and approved excerpts from named sources.
check: Verify every source ID and exact evidence quote in the model output.
result: An editorial review packet with source URLs and supporting quotations.
boundary: Quote matching proves traceability, not meaning or truth. There is no persistent review queue or automatic publication.
terms: editorial content research citations sources writing outline approval

name: Approved WordPress draft
description: Create a WordPress draft from an editor-approved title and paragraphs, then read it back.
input: Explicit approval of the exact title, paragraphs and slug.
check: Check the slug, create a missing draft and verify the saved post.
result: A verified draft identity without publishing the article.
boundary: Serial lookup is not an atomic lock. Reconcile uncertain writes and coordinate simultaneous requests for the same slug.
terms: wordpress content draft publish editorial approval

name: Transcript handoff review
description: Turn a transcript into evidence-linked decisions and proposed actions for participant review.
input: An approved transcript and its source reference.
check: Validate structured model output and supporting evidence quotations.
result: A review packet, not automatically assigned or completed tasks.
boundary: Participants still confirm speaker attribution, context and commitments. Do not send confidential transcripts without permission.
terms: transcript meeting decisions action items handoff evidence

name: Markdown to Google Docs
description: Create a formatted Google document from Markdown and verify its returned identity.
input: A document title and Markdown content.
check: Validate the document, convert formatting and read back the created file.
result: A Google Docs link for the newly created document.
boundary: Test formatting and sharing in your own account. A returned file identity does not prove every layout detail rendered correctly.
terms: markdown google docs document formatting report

name: Public-source collector
description: Collect permitted pages in bounded batches and continue from durable state after a restart.
input: An approved source scope, seeds and optional completed discovery export.
check: Apply URL scope, robots rules, pacing, budgets and content deduplication.
result: A bounded document collection, durable queue and aggregate receipts.
boundary: The offline demo uses fictional pages. Live collection needs an explicit permitted scope. This is not a browser renderer or contact-harvesting system.
terms: scraping research source crawl collector python apify deduplication restart

name: n8n failures to Linear
description: Find or create a recovery issue for an integration failure using a stable incident reference.
input: An n8n failure event and configured recovery destination.
check: Build a safe reference, search for an existing issue and verify any creation.
result: A confirmed recovery issue receipt for the operator.
boundary: Serial lookup is not a cross-execution lock. A created issue does not mean the underlying integration has recovered.
terms: error failure recovery linear issue incident alert

name: Instantly opt-out sync
description: Preview missing suppression entries before optionally applying and verifying them.
input: The complete unsubscribed-lead and blocked-entry collections.
check: Normalize identities, compare suppression coverage and inspect write receipts.
result: A preview or verified missing-block reconciliation.
boundary: It does not send campaigns. Review provider access, scope and current suppression state before enabling changes.
terms: instantly unsubscribe suppression opt out email reconciliation

name: Google Sheets email validation
description: Deduplicate a bounded sheet range and produce a reconciled email-validation report.
input: A selected spreadsheet range and email column.
check: Normalize and deduplicate addresses, then request ZeroBounce validation.
result: A reviewable CSV with validation results and reconciled counts.
boundary: Validation uses your provider account and may incur charges. A validated address is not permission to contact someone.
terms: sheets email validation zerobounce deduplicate cleansing csv

name: Inventory update plan
description: Compare complete warehouse and store snapshots before making inventory changes.
input: Two complete snapshots with compatible product identifiers.
check: Validate completeness and reconcile differences between the snapshots.
result: An update-plan CSV for human review, not direct store writes.
boundary: The planner does not infer missing stock from incomplete data or apply changes to a commerce system.
terms: inventory warehouse store stock reconciliation csv planner
